newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Lachlan Murdoch becomes News Ltd chairman.
newsitem.headline: Lachlan Murdoch becomes News Ltd chairman.

text.p: News Ltd, the Australian offshoot of Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd, said on Thursday that his elder son Lachlan had been appointed chairman from July 1.
Lachlan is already managing director of News Ltd, which is the largest metropolitan newspaper publisher in Australia.

The company said in mid-April that Lachlan would take responsibility for the Australian operations from the executive chairman of News Ltd, Ken Cowley, whose retirement takes effect at the end of June.
Lachlan is also a director of News Corp and analysts believe he now has the upper hand over his sister Elisabeth in the likely struggle to take control of the company once his father steps down.
